content:
Let \(V\) be the initial pond volume, \(I\) the inflow rate, and \(P\) the rate of one type A pump.

For 1 pump in 60 minutes:
\[
V = 60(P-I)
\]

For 2 pumps in 20 minutes:
\[
V = 20(2P-I)
\]

Equate:
\[
60(P-I)=20(2P-I)
\]
\[
3P-3I=2P-I
\]
\[
P=2I
\]

Then:
\[
V=60(2I-I)=60I
\]

For 3 pumps, net emptying rate:
\[
3P-I = 3(2I)-I = 5I
\]

Time:
\[
\frac{V}{5I}=\frac{60I}{5I}=12
\]

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
